name: Hosho Nonoka
source:
A hacker and gadget developer working for Oz’s detective agency; 10 years old.

She may not seem it, but Nonno (as she calls herself) is a cheeky girl who isn’t at all intimidated by adults. She’s firmly confident in her own abilities, and thanks to her cheerful personality, she has a lot of friends at school, too.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
